topic: the September effect / stock market seasonality
title: The One Month the Stock Market Has Lost Money For 100 Years
description:
Since 1928, September is the only month with a negative average return for the S&P 500 — down in more than half of all years, and home to more of the worst months on record than any other. This video walks through how real that pattern is, why nobody can fully explain it, why it has been fading for decades, and why trying to trade around it has a long history of costing more than the effect itself.
